content: Standard Brazilian cascading UF->cidade pattern: UF is always a fixed 27-item select (26 states + DF) keyed by 2-letter abbreviation, sourced from IBGE; cidade options are then fetched/filtered by the chosen UF. Community datasets (e.g. kelvins/municipios-brasileiros) provide the full IBGE municipality-to-UF mapping as static JSON for offline use, avoiding a live external API call. For an app deriving cidade options from its OWN existing client records (this project's stated approach) rather than the full IBGE municipality list, the standard caveat is: the cidade select must only offer values that exist for that UF among current rows, and needs a graceful empty state when a UF has zero existing clientes yet (must fall back to free text or clearly show 'nenhuma cidade cadastrada ainda').
